subject: [PATCH] x86/mm: Define the zapped-entry checks only with CONFIG_DEBUG_VM

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Provided additional context on the comparison between two kernels, one with and one without the patch. Confirmed that the patch is functionally equivalent to the original code.

reviews.author: Edgecombe, Rick P
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the appropriateness of the fixes tag and suggested that it might be more accurate to use the safe ret commits. Also noted that the patch effectively duplicates a check.

2026-11-02.patch_summary: The patch proposes to define zapped-entry checks only when CONFIG_DEBUG_VM is enabled.
